_doc: Plain code/data patches applied by insert.py. 'patch': bytes written over the source ROM (orig asserted). 'vanilla': [start, end) ranges copied back from clean FireRed. Offsets are ROM offsets.

naming_vanilla.why: Use FireRed's own name-entry screen instead of the hack's Chinese one (pinyin page, misplaced entry line). The hack hooked DoNamingScreen/CB2_LoadNamingScreen to its screen at 0x9FF5EB4/0x9FF505C, swapped the first key handler, the text-entry box template and the controls text, and redrew the buttons in Chinese. Restored here. Kept from the hack: its extended template table (literal at NamingScreen_Init 0x9DB58 -> 0x9DE4EC4: number/phrase/password/category inputs, initialPage=upper), the u16 player-avatar gfx id (0x9EF68), translated titles. Its intro calls its own screen directly (bl at 0x9FF4214, out of BL range of vanilla), so its entry becomes an ARM trampoline to vanilla DoNamingScreen; r0-r3 and stack args untouched.

patch.asm: bx pc; nop; (ARM) ldr ip,[pc]; bx ip; .word 0x0809D955 (vanilla DoNamingScreen)
hack 'Enter a number' template: initialPage upper -> others (digits page)
